title: 史萊姆雨季
description: 魔力雨讓史萊姆大量增生。公會號召冒險者清理道路；擊敗任意 5 隻怪物即可完成本週支援。
description_en: Arcane rain has multiplied the slimes. Defeat any 5 monsters this week to help keep the roads clear.
bonus: 史萊姆更常出現，並提供 1.5 倍經驗與 1.3 倍金幣。
bonus_en: Slimes appear more often and grant 1.5x EXP and 1.3x gold.

title: 哥布林懸賞令
description: 商隊接連遇襲，公會發布緊急懸賞。擊敗任意 5 隻怪物即可完成本週巡邏。
description_en: Caravans are under attack and the Guild has posted an urgent bounty. Defeat any 5 monsters to finish this week's patrol.
bonus: 哥布林更常出現，並提供 1.4 倍經驗與 1.5 倍金幣。
bonus_en: Goblins appear more often and grant 1.4x EXP and 1.5x gold.

title: 荒野獸跡
description: 躁動的野獸離開棲地，旅人需要護送。擊敗任意 5 隻怪物即可完成本週護衛。
description_en: Restless beasts are straying from their habitats. Defeat any 5 monsters to complete this week's escort duty.
bonus: 野獸更常出現，並提供 1.5 倍經驗與 1.25 倍金幣。
bonus_en: Beasts appear more often and grant 1.5x EXP and 1.25x gold.

title: 星落之兆
description: 夜空落下奇異星芒，魔物都變得躁動。擊敗任意 5 隻怪物，協助 Baba 記錄異象。
description_en: Strange starlight is making every monster restless. Defeat any 5 monsters to help Baba record the phenomenon.
bonus: 所有常規魔物提供 1.25 倍經驗與 1.25 倍金幣。
bonus_en: All common monsters grant 1.25x EXP and 1.25x gold.

title: 森林低語
description: 迷霧森林傳出不屬於人類的低語。擊敗任意 5 隻怪物，協助記錄異變。
description_en: Unnatural whispers drift through the Misty Forest. Defeat any 5 monsters to help document the disturbance.
bonus: 森林魔物更常出現，掉落率提高 1.4 倍。
bonus_en: Forest creatures appear more often and have 1.4x drop rates.

title: 蜂群警報
description: 巨大的蜂群遮住森林上空。擊敗任意 5 隻怪物，完成公會的緊急驅離任務。
description_en: A vast swarm darkens the forest sky. Defeat any 5 monsters to complete the Guild's emergency response.
bonus: 蜂群提供 1.6 倍經驗與 1.4 倍掉落率。
bonus_en: Swarm creatures grant 1.6x EXP and 1.4x drop rates.

title: 亡者不眠
description: 墓園鐘聲在無人敲響時迴盪。擊敗任意 5 隻怪物，替守墓人減輕壓力。
description_en: The graveyard bell rings with no hand upon it. Defeat any 5 monsters to aid the exhausted keeper.
bonus: 不死魔物提供 1.4 倍經驗、1.4 倍金幣與 1.25 倍掉落率。
bonus_en: Undead grant 1.4x EXP, 1.4x gold, and 1.25x drop rates.

title: 商路掃蕩
description: 盜匪趁著商隊繁忙四處搶掠。擊敗任意 5 隻怪物，恢復道路秩序。
description_en: Outlaws are preying on busy caravans. Defeat any 5 monsters to restore order along the roads.
bonus: 盜匪與哥布林提供 1.5 倍金幣與 1.3 倍掉落率。
bonus_en: Outlaws and goblins grant 1.5x gold and 1.3x drop rates.
